guide is the text of the Providers tab: how hard the setup is (level 1-4 and ease), a summary, the steps, and what is good or to watch. Shown with the signup link.

signup.text: No key? Sign up for Requesty

guide.summary: Sign up, add credit, make a key, then check which models your key may use.
steps: Sign up at Requesty with the link below.
Create an API key and paste it at the top of this page.
If a model answers that it is not allowed, check the dashboard: the organization's approved models, and any access list on your key or its group.
good: Works straight from this page (GitHub Pages), no server needed.
Decisions (pick among answers with probabilities) are tested best here.
watch: Models are managed in lists in the dashboard, so a new model may need adding before it answers.
